candidates.title: Replay with an independent checker

hypothesis_discrimination_targets.discriminating_observation: The independent checker reproduces the registered result without sharing implementation state.
hypothesis_discrimination_targets.expected_if_hypothesis: The registered effect appears with the independent checker.
hypothesis_discrimination_targets.expected_if_alternative: The effect disappears or follows an implementation-specific artifact.
hypothesis_discrimination_targets.would_weaken_if: The independent checker fails to reproduce the registered result.

candidates.rationale: Tests whether the result depends on one checker implementation.
